gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent WHO grade 4 glioblastoma or gliosarcoma, including molecular features of glioblastoma and WHO grade 4 astrocytoma or WHO grade high grade glioma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Epacadostat will be administered orally at 400 mg BID.
The investigators hypothesize that this combination provides a powerful synergy between RT and immune modulators to produce more robust anti-tumor immune response

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Disease must have recurred, and patient must be a candidate for re-irradiation and bevacizumab.

role_evidence.quote: Retifanlimab will be given intravenously over the course of 30 to 60 minutes at a dose of 500 mg on Day 1 of each 28-day cycle.
combine retifanlimab with radiation therapy (RT) and bevacizumab with or without epacadostat

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: synergy between RT and immune modulators to produce more robust anti-tumor immune response

role_evidence.quote: Epacadostat will be administered orally at 400 mg BID.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: immune modulation to produce more robust anti-tumor immune response

role_evidence.quote: Bevacizumab will be given intravenously at a dose of 10 mg/kg on Days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.

coder_notes: Retifanlimab is the only investigational agent in Regimen A (would be monotherapy there) and one of two in Regimen B; coded experimental_combination as the fuller case. Both arms are experimental, non-randomised, sequential; Regimen A could act as a reference for B but is not a registered control. Bevacizumab given identically in both arms with re-irradiation, coded soc_backbone. Population is grade 4 glioma without IDH requirement (IDH-mutant not excluded), coded gbm_only/historical.
